build_ATSSHead: build an ATSSHead instance with num_classes and in_channels for object detection
forward_ATSSHead: run the ATSSHead forward pass on feature tensors to get cls_scores and bbox_preds
loss_by_feat_ATSSHead: calculate detection loss from cls_scores, bbox_preds, and centernesses against ground truth instances
centerness_target_ATSSHead: compute centerness targets between anchor boxes and ground truth bounding boxes
get_targets_ATSSHead: get classification and regression targets for anchors using adaptive training sample selection
